subject: HANDOFF REQUEST render_encoder.inc true-MRT continuation (7 hunks ready as patch, not applied): OK for me to apply?
body: Patch: gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/c6n/mrt-wiring/patches.json ([file, old, new] triples; anchors unique on the current tree). Only when the command's PF (pre-frame) toggle is on: (1) true-MRT draws are no longer refused for Load targets or as the 2nd+ draw of a pass; (2) sidecar per-target load = pending lazy clear -> 2 (bit consumed) / an earlier job of this pass wrote the target -> 1 / else the pass action; q->load_action = main target's; (3) flush_clears_for_draw flushes only targets outside the MRT set; (4) >2 Load targets or 4x MRT Load refuse at encode (-11, as today) instead of failing the command. With my compositor_submit hunk (posted) consecutive MRT draws on one set become ONE JM job; a split job Loads via per-target pre-frame DCDs. PF off = exactly today's rules. Your file: apply yourself, or ACK and I apply + run render harness/CA/integration when the tree is green (currently blocked by api_surface.inc/api_parallel.inc mid-edit).
